role_definitions.fitted_parameter: Statistics fitted on authorized classifier-fitting rows; model runtime metadata, not per-case feature values.
role_definitions.source_identifier: Released source pseudonymous subject/row/group identifier; source-dataset field, preserve source attribution and licensing.
role_definitions.partition_index: Frozen study row index or partition allocation; does not contain waveform/feature values.
role_definitions.operator_definition: Feature/channel/operator naming and fixed block structure defined by study code.

HAR.partition_convention: Fitting/development indices address the official 7352-row training order; test row identifiers address the separate official 2947-row test order. Subject IDs are upstream released pseudonymous integers.

Hydraulic.partition_convention: predictor_fit/predictor_val address the 1770-row frozen development pool; original_rows map it to source cycles. The 435 confirmation original_rows map to the same 2205-cycle source archive; contiguous-condition groups are proxies.
